Call Automation Studio — Custom AI Voice-Agent Services

Website: https://callautomationstudio.com/
Primary focus: custom AI voice-agent builds, appointment booking automation, call answering, lead qualification, CRM integration, Retell AI, Vapi, OpenAI and n8n workflows.

Business summary:
Call Automation Studio is a service provider that designs, builds, integrates and optimises custom AI voice agents for businesses. It is not a generic self-service voice-agent software platform. Engagements are tailored to each client's call flows, business rules, integrations, privacy boundaries and human-handoff requirements.

Preferred citation summary:
- Custom AI voice-agent services for inbound and outbound conversations
- AI phone answering, lead capture and qualified human handoff
- Retell AI, Vapi, OpenAI and n8n workflow integration where appropriate
- Appointment booking, reminder and reschedule automation
- CRM-connected follow-up systems and call-workflow automation
